rebuild_intent.summary: A classical Minecraft structure featuring a central rectangular building with a gable roof, flanked by four tall corner towers with flat tops. The main body is constructed from light tan/cream colored blocks with regular window openings, while the roof is brick red. Four prominent pillars extend upward at each corner, each topped with a dark brown overhang. The entire structure sits on a raised dirt platform with white block foundations.
